note.question: How should last-mile deliveries be crowdsourced?
note.overview: Because of the emergence and development of e-commerce, customers demand faster and cheaper delivery services. However, many retailers find it challenging to efficiently provide fast and on-time delivery services to their customers. Amazon and Walmart are among the retailers that are relying on independent crowd drivers to cope with on-demand delivery expectations.
